name: Thebez
overview: Thebez is a city notable in Scripture as the place where Abimelech met his death while attempting to conquer it. During the siege, Abimelech fought against a strong tower within the city where the inhabitants had taken refuge. As he tried to set the tower on fire, a woman cast a millstone upon his head, fatally wounding him, after which he asked his armor-bearer to kill him to avoid the shame of dying by a woman’s hand. This event led to the dispersal of the men of Israel, marking the end of Abimelech's campaign at Thebez.
